card.title: Affectionate Resentment
card.instruction: Remain warm and familiar while letting old resentment sharpen beneath every caring gesture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've warmed your side of the bed, love. You sounded frozen waiting for that taxi.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You could have picked me up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I could. Here's another blanket. I remember waiting outside your office last Christmas.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I apologised. Could you warm my feet?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come here, love. Both feet. I wouldn't leave any part of you waiting forty minutes.

mechanism: A gives warmth and physical care while letting an old waiting grievance color each new accommodation.
confusable: Unlike refusing comfort as punishment, A must stay warmly available while making the resentment increasingly pointed.
comparison: D93-b uses both feet to revisit a long wait; D93-a uses a protected flame to revisit an unfinished birthday call.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
